Catch Shawn Gardini, the deadpan maestro from "Gilly and Keeves," in Houston this Friday. Known for his sharp, absurd humor, Shawn's style has made him a cult favorite. He's been on "Matt and Shane's Secret Podcast" and "Kill Tony," and now he's bringing his unique comedy to The Gordy. Don't miss a night of laughs with Philly's own.

Catch Isabel Hagen’s TV special "Isabel Hagen at the Bitter End" yet? 🌟 Houston, you're in for a treat. Isabel blends deadpan humor with her classical viola, diving into personal tales with a twist. Known for her existential musings and that unforgettable Jimmy Fallon appearance, she's a must-see. Her stories are raw, real, and resonate with anyone who's felt a little out of place. Join us for a night of unique comedy. 

The Riot Comedy Club upstairs at Rudyard's · Friday, April 3, 2026

Matthew Broussard's "Hyperbolic" special is streaming, but nothing beats seeing him live. Known for mixing sharp wit with personal stories, Matthew's comedy dives into everything from physics to mental health. His heady, self-effacing style makes learning just as fun as laughing. Catch him in action and see why he's a standout on shows like "The Tonight Show" and "Conan."

LeMaire Lee has been cracking up listeners on "Panties in the Mouth" and "Matt and Shane’s Secret Podcast." Houston, he's bringing that same quick wit and charm to Rudyard's. LeMaire's Detroit roots and Philly hustle make him a unique voice on stage — a mix of raw honesty and sharp humor. His shows are like hanging out with a friend who sees the world in the funniest way possible. Don't miss this chance to see him live.
